facts: Honey badgers hunt venomous snakes, and in one famous filmed case a badger knocked out by a cobra bite woke up hours later and simply finished eating the snake.
Their skin is thick and so loose that predators struggle to get a grip, and they can twist around inside it to bite back at whatever is holding them.
They weigh only about 8 to 12 kilograms, yet they have been filmed chasing off lions, hyenas, and leopards that made the mistake of getting too close.
In captivity they have been caught unlocking gates, stacking objects to climb walls, and escaping enclosures, earning a reputation as stubborn escape artists.
